question: how many sales are there
expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales

question: quantas vendas existem
expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales

question: total amount of paid sales
expected_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM sales WHERE status = 'paid'

question: total de vendas por cidade
expected_sql: SELECT c.city, sum(s.amount) FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id GROUP BY c.city

question: top 5 products by revenue
expected_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(s.amount) AS revenue FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: ticket médio das vendas em março de 2026
expected_sql: SELECT avg(amount) FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND sold_at < DATE '2026-04-01'

question: how many sales per month
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', sold_at) AS month, count(*) AS sales FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
